# Limitless

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 0 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: A quiet light marketing site after an acquisition: white page, slate 900 display at 60px with tight tracking, Greycliff, purple-500 used only on the star and one filled action, pill nav, a 24px letter card, and a sign-in card that opens Sign Up Unavailable for a new email.

Captured 2026-11-18, signed-out public marketing, docs, legal, help center, and the app.limitless.ai sign-in wall; a 2026-11-18 signed-in pass submitted the email field only (never Google) and stopped at Sign Up Unavailable (Limitless is no longer accepting new users). Lifelogs, settings and account were not entered. No Pendant purchased. No CAPTCHA, phone or payment.. Themes: light.

Tokens and component notes for Limitless (limitless.ai), captured **2026-11-18**. Desktop is 1440×900. Phone is 390×844. One light theme. Public routes: `/`, `/privacy`, `/developers`, `/about`, `/careers`, `/support`, `/terms`, `/privacy-policy`, `/for/voice-recorder`, `/for/students`, the `/pricing` 404, `app.limitless.ai/signin` (the wall), and `help.limitless.ai/en/`. Signed-in attempt: the email field at `https://app.limitless.ai/signin` was submitted (never Google). Limitless answered with **Sign Up Unavailable**: it is no longer accepting new users. Lifelogs, settings and account were not entered. No Pendant was bought. No CAPTCHA, phone or payment appeared.

Limitless marketing is Tailwind/Next.js on Greycliff. Colour is utility classes (slate, zinc, purple-500). The app host also declares shadcn HSL variables ([raw/app-css-vars.json](raw/app-css-vars.json)). The home page is an acquisition letter.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

- Lifelogs, settings and account. Submitting a new email at `https://app.limitless.ai/signin` opens Sign Up Unavailable. The product is no longer accepting new users. Continue with Google was not pressed.
- Pendant checkout. The dialog and the marketing site both say the Pendant is not sold to new customers. No purchase flow was opened.
- Support chat on `/support`. It is a third-party widget. It was not opened.
- Help search results and article pages. The field was focused and not queried.
- Ashby careers and the Slack community invite. Both leave the site.
- Greycliff files. The family name is measured. The files are not in this package.
- Pressed states. They are forced pseudo-classes.
- Reduced motion. The product ignores it. That is recorded, not corrected.
- Hand-entered values. `core.color.slate.200` (`#e2e8f0`, so `light.border`), `core.color.zinc.500` (`#71717a`), `light.helpBand` (`#8a54e1`), `core.elevation.popover` and `core.elevation.dialog`, `core.space.1`, `.3`, `.5` and `.16`, and `core.layout.page`, `.phone` and `.navHeight` were entered by hand at capture time. No raw reading holds them: the Solutions panel, the dialog close icon, the help header band and the top bar were not measured, and the measured dialog card computes no box-shadow. They are labelled Reconstruction in tokens.json.
- Values corrected to the readings (2026-11 audit): `core.font.size.menu` 13px to the measured 12.8px; `core.typography.heading` line-height 41px to 41.4px, with the measured -0.9px tracking; `core.typography.body-lg` line-height 29px to 29.25px; `core.elevation.card` colour slate 900 to the measured slate 800 at 15%; `core.elevation.control` from one invented 0 1px 2px layer to the carousel button's two measured layers; `core.font.family.mono` now carries the whole measured stack.
- The Sign Up Unavailable readings ([raw/gated-dialog.json](raw/gated-dialog.json), the gated screenshots) were taken after an email was submitted to the live sign-in form, a state change the capture rules now treat as a boundary. No committed script performs that submit.
- components.md was written at capture time; no builder in tools/ regenerates it.
- The phone sign-in shot is 1x. That host reports `devicePixelRatio` 1 while Playwright still writes a 2x PNG, so the shot was taken at 1x to match the page.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

1. **Do paint a white page and slate type.** Page is white, titles are slate 900, body is slate 600 ([home](screenshots/home-light-default.png)).
2. **Do spend purple on the mark and the one filled action.** Purple 500 is the star, the Copy button and developer anchors ([Copy](components/crops/copy-button-default.png)).
3. **Do use pills in the bar.** Nav links and Solutions are 9999px radius, 16px/600, with an 8% slate wash on hover ([nav](components/crops/nav-link-hover.png)).
4. **Do set display at 60px with tight tracking.** The acquisition headline and solution titles are 60px, tracking -1.5px ([hero](components/crops/hero-title-default.png)).
5. **Do round the letter card at 24px.** The acquisition letter is a soft card, not a flat column ([card](components/crops/letter-card-default.png)).
6. **Do keep the sign-in card quiet.** White, 8px radius, one Google button, one email field, on a pale field ([sign-in](screenshots/signin-light-default.png)).
7. **Don't invent a dark theme.** The public site does not paint one.
8. **Don't style lifelogs or settings from this package.** Those screens were not reached ([unavailable](screenshots/signin-light-signup-unavailable.png)).
9. **Don't follow Continue with Google.** OAuth was not used ([sign-in wall](screenshots/signin-light-default.png)).
10. **Don't copy the star or the Greycliff files.** The mark and the typeface are Limitless's. Tokens name the system.
11. **Don't expect a new email to open the app.** Sign Up Unavailable is the gate ([dialog](components/crops/signup-unavailable-dialog-default.png)).
